card.name: Words just before "measure" in dosing devices
card.fires_on: Small words like "to", "a", "an" right before the verb "measure" or a measuring device, in oral liquid dosing directions. Often follows "household teaspoons or tablespoons".

modes.label: "to" before measure
modes.description: The word "to" after a warning not to use household spoons, where "measure" comes next.
modes.example: Do not use household teaspoons or tablespoons<< to>> measure Oxycodone Hydrochloride

modes.label: article before a device
modes.description: "a" or "an" introducing a measuring device such as a graduated teaspoon or oral syringe.
modes.example: A calibrated measuring device, such as<< an>> oral syringe or oral dosing cup

card.writes: It pushes the model to output "measure", "measuring" and "measurement" next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before "measure" when the label explains how to measure a liquid dose.
